items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Stock May Be 39% Undervalued As Nashville Buildout Starts
items.summary: Oracle shares have come under pressure, with the recent slide raising a blunt question for anyone looking at the stock today. Is the current US$110.57 price still supported by the cash the business is expected to generate over time, or has sentiment moved faster than its underlying economics. Over the past year the share price has fallen 46.8%, which puts the focus squarely on whether that reset now lines up with the value implied by Oracle's cash flows. items.title: Why CoreWeave Can't Pay Down Debt From Its Cash
items.summary: CoreWeave does not pay for its growth from its own cash, let alone pay down its debt. Over the four quarters to September 2026, it spent $27.6 billion on equipment and buildings. That spending is called capital spending, or capex. The cash its business brought in, called operating cash flow, covered only 26.1% of it.
